reference_basis.instruction: Preserve structural identity while excluding chef clothing, kitchen context, work pose, and lens perspective.

face_geometry.description: Long oval-to-angular face with high prominent cheekbones, moderate cheek width, a clearly defined lower jaw, and firm rounded-square chin. Strong and feminine, never gaunt or severe.

eyes.description: Cool grey-green almond eyes, slightly deep-set, average spacing, with modest lid exposure and subtly lifted outer corners; steady self-possessed gaze.

brows.description: Thick medium-to-dark brown brows set relatively low, mostly straight with a restrained outer arch and natural dense texture.

nose.description: Straight prominent medium-long nose with defined bridge and softly squared-to-rounded tip. Maintain projection and length.

mouth.description: Medium-wide mouth with a restrained upper lip, fuller lower lip, softly defined cupid's bow, and composed resting corners.

skin.description: Fair neutral skin with rosy cheeks and nose, subtle freckles across the central face and arms, visible pores, and light natural warmth.

hair.description: Thick medium-brown hair with warm variation, natural texture and slight wave, around or below shoulder length. Styling is mutable; base density and colour remain stable.

body_proportions.description: Tall naturally sturdy softly athletic frame with broad capable shoulders, substantial torso, strong forearms and hands, and long balanced limbs; practical strength without extreme leanness.

identity_relationships.cheek_to_jaw_transition: high cheekbone plane narrows through a defined but not pinched jaw
identity_relationships.nose_to_mouth_relationship: prominent nose length balanced by a medium-wide grounded mouth
identity_relationships.lip_ratio: lower lip clearly fuller than upper
identity_relationships.feature_balance: cheekbones, nose, jaw, and low strong brows create mature structural identity

expression_behavior.neutral: Composed and slightly serious, with level gaze and relaxed closed lips.
expression_behavior.smile: Mouth widens and softens markedly, revealing warmth while jaw and cheekbone structure remain visible.
expression_behavior.cheek_response: Rosy cheeks lift beneath high cheekbones without becoming round or childlike.
expression_behavior.eye_response: Eyes soften and narrow modestly; outer corners lift slightly.

signature_features.feature: high cheekbones and defined long facial structure
strong forearms and hands within a tall sturdy frame

negative_identity_constraints: do not soften away her defining bone structure
